def transform(g):
    H,W=len(g),len(g[0])
    fc=g[0][0]
    # left block width: first all-zero column
    sep=next(c for c in range(W) if all(g[r][c]==0 for r in range(H)))
    LW=sep
    # frame rows (all frame color in left block)
    frame_rows=[r for r in range(H) if all(g[r][c]==fc for c in range(LW))]
    blocks=[]; r=0
    while r<H:
        if r in frame_rows: r+=1; continue
        r2=r
        while r2<H and r2 not in frame_rows: r2+=1
        blocks.append((r,r2)); r=r2
    holes=[]
    for (a,b) in blocks:
        n=sum(1 for rr in range(a,b) for c in range(LW) if g[rr][c]==0)
        holes.append({'rows':(a,b),'n':n})
    # right shapes: components by color
    seen=[[False]*W for _ in range(H)]; shapes=[]
    for rr in range(H):
        for c in range(sep+1,W):
            if g[rr][c] and not seen[rr][c]:
                col=g[rr][c]; stack=[(rr,c)]; seen[rr][c]=True; n=0
                while stack:
                    y,x=stack.pop(); n+=1
                    for dy,dx in((1,0),(-1,0),(0,1),(0,-1)):
                        ny,nx=y+dy,x+dx
                        if 0<=ny<H and sep<nx<W and g[ny][nx]==col and not seen[ny][nx]:
                            seen[ny][nx]=True; stack.append((ny,nx))
                shapes.append({'col':col,'n':n})
    shapes.sort(key=lambda s:s['n']); holes.sort(key=lambda h:h['n'])
    assign={h['rows']: s['col'] for h,s in zip(holes,shapes)}
    out=[]
    for rr in range(H):
        blk=next((k for k in assign if k[0]<=rr<k[1]),None)
        out.append([fc if g[rr][c]!=0 else (assign[blk] if blk else 0) for c in range(LW)])
    return out
print(transform(G['Demo pair 1 input'])==G['Demo pair 1 output'])
